labs.name: Mechanical Engineering
labs.scope: Shafts, bearings, gears, linkages and machine elements. Stage 1: geometry preview and component library. Stage 2: kinematics and stress analysis.

labs.name: Electrical Engineering
labs.scope: DC/AC circuits, power, signals and microcontrollers. Stage 1: component library and workspace. Stage 2: circuit simulation with an open SPICE-type solver.

labs.name: Structural Engineering
labs.scope: Beams, columns, frames and connections. Stage 1: frame geometry preview and section library. Stage 2: frame analysis and code checks.
labs.tagline: Frames, beams and buildings that stand up.

labs.name: Aerospace Engineering
labs.scope: Wings, airfoils, propulsion and lightweight structures. Stage 1: wing geometry preview and airfoil reference. Stage 2: lift/drag estimation and structural check.

labs.name: Robotics Engineering
labs.scope: Robot arms, actuators, sensors and motion. Stage 1: arm geometry preview and actuator library. Stage 2: forward/inverse kinematics and dynamics.

labs.name: Materials Science
labs.scope: Metals, polymers, composites and their properties. Stage 1: searchable materials database with typical published values. Stage 2: material selection and comparison tools.
labs.tagline: What things are made of — and why it matters.
